Maya — thanks for the clear ask and the materials. Looping in Laura (Head of Legal Partnerships) and Aditya (Sales lead on the account) so we can align legal and commercial tradeoffs.

Quick thoughts:
- 24h notification: operationally we can commit to "initial notification within 24 hours of detection for incidents materially affecting customer data security." We need to keep the statutory/regulatory step-in (forensics may extend timeline) language to allow a short follow-up with an incident summary (72h) and final report (30 days).
- Subprocessors: we publish an up-to-date subprocessor list and offer 30 days' advance notice for new subprocessors for EU data when technically possible. We cannot granularly guarantee approval vetoes for every new infra provider, but we can include an escalation path and the option to restrict certain data flows (e.g., tokenization keys) to dedicated capacity.

I'll prepare a redline to return with the suggested wording and include a DocuSign-ready version if this is acceptable.

Priya — attached is our proposed redline (Redlines_v2.docx) and a short cover note. Summary of the changes we propose:
- Breach notification: commit to an "initial notification within 24 hours of detection that confirms whether PII exposure is suspected (yes/no) and whether tokenization secrets were impacted;" follow-up incident summary within 72 hours and a root-cause/final report within 30 days.
- Subprocessors: we agree to publish an active subprocessor list and provide 30 days' advance notice for new subprocessors that will process EU personal data. We can provide a contractual right to object with a 14-day cure/mitigation window; if an agreement cannot be reached we will offer routing to dedicated capacity or contractual controls where possible.

Commercial note: the dedicated capacity routing/technical isolation option is available under Redwood Dedicated or as an add-on for private deployments; if StratusPay needs hard guarantees around where tokenization keys live, we should scope Dedicated in parallel.

For execution we can prepare DocuSign — I will include an exec-signed shortform (Exec_Approval_Shortform.pdf) to speed things up once legal signs off. If you need any further tweaks to the language I can escalate to Laura for sign-off.

Thanks,
Vivek
